Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.66.0

The optional offline narration renderer uses the separately installed Piper
1.8.0 engine (GPL-3.0) and a separately downloaded pt_BR-faber-medium voice.
Piper is not bundled into this website. The voice model card identifies its
training dataset license as CC0. See:
https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl
https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/pt/pt_BR/faber/medium/MODEL_CARD

The articulated mechanism and environment geometry in production/assets3d.ts
is original project code. No images or video frames from the reference are
used as scene assets.
